title: EvidenceRecord
description: Canonical schema for multimodal evidence records in AI-Reality-Reconstructor

id.description: Unique identifier for the evidence record (UUIDv4)

case_id.description: Identifier of the investigation case this evidence belongs to

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 formatted capture or recorded timestamp, or null if unknown

source.description: Original source file path or URI

confidence.description: Epistemic confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0, or null

status.description: Epistemic status of the evidence record
